generation.reproducibility_note: Actual full prompts and reference hashes recorded; model and seed unavailable. No separate API key or CLI fallback used.
sequence: generate all landscape masters, prioritizing chaerin ep01-ep05
generate each portrait with its landscape PNG as reference

art_direction.camera: seated laptop webcam height, frontal horizontal view
art_direction.style: original painterly anime background with soft shallow-depth-of-field treatment

palette.scene_light: sunset, daylight, neutral fluorescent or evening electric task lights depending on scene; white room deliberately brighter

character_safe_area.description: central lower region kept low-detail and free of foreground props for an upper-body Live2D overlay

style_reference.role: visually inspected style and safe-area guide; not supplied as generation image input

notes: Central lower foreground has no props; low-detail architectural lines and window sill may remain in background.
Chaerin ep05 uses faceless abstract original shelf ornaments instead of figurative character merchandise to honor no-character constraint.

visual_review.review_method: visual inspection of every generated image plus programmatic final size and format verification

outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one original painterly anime background only, landscape 4:3, full bleed, no people. Scene: empty contemporary high-school second-year classroom by the windows on a late spring afternoon after school, orange sunset entering left rectangular windows, erased chalk smudges on blank board at upper right, desks only at outer edges. Camera at seated laptop webcam height looking straight horizontally into classroom. Soft painted edges and gentle shallow depth of field. Dominant navy violet shadows #0F0E17 #2A1F4A with restrained #7E54F6 accents and orange daylight; never gold-dominated. Crucial Live2D overlay composition: x28–72%, y35–100% must be calm low-detail empty wall/floor tones, absolutely no desks, chairs or props within this central lower rectangle; peripheral classroom furniture frames the empty center naturally. No literal cutout. No text, letters, logos, brands, real locations, watermarks, people, faces, silhouettes, characters or animals. Blank board and book covers. Single scene only.

outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, reference-guided companion. Generate one PORTRAIT 3:4 full-bleed original painterly anime background of the EXACT SAME interior as the reference landscape master. Reference is scene/layout/lighting/style continuity source. Recompose for taller frame, preserving distinctive windows, furnishing designs, left/right arrangement, palette and time of day; no new room. Seated laptop-webcam height horizontal frontal view, soft painted edges, gentle depth-of-field. CRUCIAL: keep normalized x28-72%, y35-100% empty low-detail wall/floor and free of ALL furniture/props; peripheral objects remain outside this rectangle even in portrait. No cutout. No people, faces, silhouettes, animals, letters, text, digits, logos, real places, watermarks, brands, border or collage. Screens/packaging/books blank or abstract. Navy violet shadows with scene lighting, never gold dominated. Scene continuity: Late spring sunset empty high-school classroom, left windows and orange daylight, blank erased chalkboard at upper right, edge desks, same space.
